limit_margin_basis: Enabled 2026-09-13: the reviewed shot drove light shoulder_lift to 773 counts, its exact mechanical stop, at t=1.76 s, which the operator saw as the arm dropping. The planner now keeps this many degrees off each end of travel and solves inside that range. This is a planning margin, not a measurement; firmware limits and the original calibration are unchanged.
range_basis: Operator instruction on 2026-09-12: use the original calibration as the joint position limits; assume ideal cables and mechanical stops. This is an operating assumption, not a new measurement.
note: Nominal SO101 mapping with operator-authorized observed maximum revisions. zero_offsets_deg compensates changes in the normalization midpoint so the same raw encoder reading retains its model angle. Originals and firmware homing are unchanged.
